units.source_text: 内大臣说：“春日之花，不拘梅杏桃李，开出之时，各有香色，无不令人惊叹。

en.t: The Minister of the Interior said, "Spring flowers, whether plum, apricot, peach, or cherry plum, each have their own fragrance and color when they bloom, and all are wonderfully moving.

units.source_text: 然而为时皆甚短暂，一转瞬间，即抛却了赏花人而纷纷散落。

en.t: Yet their season is always very brief; in the blink of an eye they abandon those who admire them and scatter away.

units.source_text: 正当惜花送春之时，这藤花独姗姗来迟，一直开到夏天，异常令人赏心悦目。

en.t: Just when one is lamenting the flowers and seeing spring off, these wisteria blossoms alone arrive late and linger into summer, giving extraordinary pleasure to the eye.

units.source_text: 这色彩教人联想起可爱的人儿呢。”他说时面露微笑，风度十分优雅。

en.t: This color makes one think of someone lovely." As he spoke, he smiled, and his manner was exceedingly graceful.

units.source_text: 月亮出来了，清光暗淡，花色难于辨认。

en.t: The moon had risen, but its clear light was faint, and the colors of the flowers were hard to distinguish.

units.source_text: 然而还是以赏花为由，传杯劝酒，唱歌作乐。

en.t: Even so, they used flower viewing as a pretext, passing cups, urging one another to drink, singing, and making merry.

units.source_text: 不久之后，内大臣佯装喝醉，举止历乱，频频持杯向夕雾劝酒。

en.t: Before long, the Minister of the Interior pretended to be drunk, let his behavior grow disordered, and repeatedly pressed a cup of wine on Yugiri.

units.source_text: 夕雾心有戒备，婉言恳辞，颇感苦劳。

en.t: Yugiri was on his guard, and he had a hard time politely but firmly refusing.

units.source_text: 内大臣对他说道：“在这衰微的末世，你是绰绰有余的天下有识之士。

en.t: The Minister of the Interior said to him, "In this declining latter age, you are more than worthy to be counted among the learned men of the realm.

units.source_text: 但你舍弃了我这个残年之人，实在太无情了。

en.t: But you have abandoned me, an old man in his remaining years, and that is truly heartless.

units.source_text: 古籍中有‘家礼’之说。

en.t: The old books speak of the rites within the family.

units.source_text: 孔孟之教你定然深通。

en.t: You must surely understand the teachings of Confucius and Mencius in great depth.

units.source_text: 但你不肯视我如父，忤我太甚，教我好恨啊！”

en.t: Yet you refuse to regard me as a father and defy me so grievously that I cannot help resenting it!"

units.source_text: 想是醉后感伤之故吧，他委婉地发了一会牢骚。

en.t: Perhaps it was drunken sentimentality, but he went on grumbling in this roundabout way for a while.

units.source_text: 夕雾连忙道歉：“舅父何出此言！

en.t: Yugiri hastened to apologize: "Uncle, why would you say such a thing?

units.source_text: 小甥孝敬舅父，与从前孝敬外祖父母和母亲一样，粉身碎骨，在所不惜。

en.t: Your nephew honors you just as he once honored his maternal grandparents and his mother, and would not spare even his body and bones in your service.

units.source_text: 不知舅父有何所见而出此言？

en.t: I do not know what you have seen that would make you speak so.

units.source_text: 想必是小甥一时疏忽，有所怠慢之故吧。”

en.t: It must be because I was careless for a moment and failed you in some way."

units.source_text: 内大臣看见良时已到，便振作精神，唱起“春日照藤花，末叶尽舒展……”的古歌来。

en.t: Seeing that the right moment had come, the Minister of the Interior roused himself and began to sing the old song, "The spring sun shines on the wisteria blossoms, and the youngest leaves spread wide..."

units.source_text: 头中将柏木早承父亲授意，此时便向庭中折取一枝色浓而穗长的藤花，添附在夕雾的酒杯上，向他敬酒。

en.t: Kashiwagi, the Captain, had already received his father's instructions, so he went into the garden, broke off a branch of deeply colored wisteria with long clusters, attached it to Yugiri's cup, and offered him wine.

units.source_text: 夕雾接了酒杯，色甚狼狈。

en.t: Yugiri accepted the cup, looking terribly discomfited.

units.source_text: 内大臣吟诗云：

en.t: The Minister of the Interior then recited a poem:
